title: Strength Training
description: Build strength, confidence, and proper technique in this focused, small group training class. With coaching from a certified personal trainer and a supportive team environment, you’ll learn how to safely and effectively workout. REC/IM MEMEBERSHIP REQUIRE

title: COE Ranking Celebration
description: To celebrate the COE's ranking in the top 100 colleges of education in the nation and the top regional college in the state of Michigan.

title: Rachel Harris "Reel Beginnings"
description: Trained in Poland’s newly established postwar film schools, Polish Holocaust survivors became foundational figures in the creation of Israel's new national film industry.

title: Casual Connections
description: This event provides students with an opportunity to meet with CAPS, Counseling Services, the DRC, the Ombuds, and other student support services in a casual, nonthreatening environment. Students can drop in anytime for a FREE Starbucks voucher.

title: Functional Training
description: Boost strength, stability, and mobility with this dynamic full-body workout! Our Functional Training class uses bodyweight exercises and equipment to improve real-life movement patterns, enhance performance, prevent injury. REC/IM MEMEBERSHIP REQUIRED

title: Power Yoga
description: A fusion of traditional yoga and resistance training, designed to build muscle, enhance strength, and improve flexibility. In this class, you’ll flow through yoga poses while incorporating dumbbells to intensify your workout. REC/IM MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.

title: Fuel Up and Wind Down: Ending the Semester Strong
description: Join the Honors College for one last hurrah before finals! We will have pancakes, a karaoke room (w/colorful disco lights), bingo, coloring pages, and more! Stop by for dinner, a space to hang out with friends, and make some memories before summer break!

title: The Honors Recital
description: The School of Music & Dance will feature some of its best and brightest Music students in solo and small group performances on stage in Alexander Recital Hall.  Free and open to the public.  Reception to follow.

title: Cycle 45
description: A high energy cardio workout that works the body using various resistance and speed levels. This class offers an intense cardio blast on the bikes simulating a real life road course up and down hills and through speed intervals! REC/IM MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED

title: Mat Pilates
description: This Pilates class will target the whole body through a variation of strength and endurance exercises. Using a mat and additional Pilates equipment, this class will work to improve strength, flexibility, and mind body connection. RECIM MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED

title: H2O Fit
venue: Rec Im Building - Jones Pool, Lanes 1-3
description: H2O Fit combines cardio, strength, and flexibility training using the natural resistance of water. Perfect for all fitness levels, this class improves endurance, strengthens muscles, and reduces joint stress while having fun. REC/IM MEMEBERSHIP REQUIRED

title: Theraputic Thursday
description:
Tabling event at the EMU REC/IM, promoting wellness to the student body of EMU.
Each week, we do a different wellness-related activity at the table.

title: AAAS Celebration and Awards
description: Join AAAS faculty and students for our end-of-year celebration and award ceremony!

title: Reimagining Restorative Justice Practices with Dr. Fania Davis
description: Join the College of Education's Learning Collective for a moderated discussion via Zoom with Dr. Fania Davis, a leading scholar and advocate for restorative justice.

title: Junior Recital: Rose Kilburn, Cello
description: EMU CELLO proudly presents a junior recital by Music Education major, Rose Kilburn. Program will include works by Graciela Agudelo, Debussy, and Elgar!

title: Cycle & Sculpt
description: A high-energy, full-body workout combining both cardio and strength training. Class begins with a cycling session to elevate your heart rate and increase cardiovascular endurance. Then, transition off the bike for strength! REC/IM MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED

title: Butts & Guts
description: This high energy class will leave you feeling accomplished! One of our fitness instructors will lead you through a variety of lower body and core exercises that will strengthen and sculpt your body. REC/IM MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.

title: "Last Day" Jam Session
description: EMU Jazz students will celebrate the celebrate the last day of classes with a jazz jam session from 12-1pm on Friday, April 24 outside in the Alexander Music Building breezeway.  Feel free to bring your lunch and enjoy some noon hour entertainment!

title: Saturday Tour
description: Join us for a Saturday campus tour to explore Eastern Michigan University! These larger group tours offer a great overview of campus, student life, and academic opportunities.

title: Luke Schleuning Junior Percussion Recital
description: Come enjoy Luke Schleuning's Junior Percussion Recital!

title: Anything Goes, Student Choreography Concert
description: "Anything Goes", a student choreography concert, featuring the choreography of dance majors/minor and dance by Company E, EMU Dance's official performing company.

title: Sarah Jerica Sales, Mezzo Soprano - Senior Recital
description: Mezzo Soprano Sarah Jerica Sales gives her Senior Recital on Saturday, April 25th in the Honors College Auditorium at 7pm. This event is free to the public and is a non-ticketed event.

title: Hunter Fishpaw Senior Clarinet Recital
description: Hunter Fishpaw will present a Senior Clarinet Recital on April 26th at noon. Come and enjoy works by D'Rivera, Marquez and Spohr!

title: Alex Hibbitts Percussion Recital
description: Come enjoy Alex Hibbitts' final percussion recital at EMU!

title: Dissertation Defense - Alina Dillahunt
description: Title: "Characterization of Cognitive Functioning and Resting-State Electroencephalography Connectivity in Preschool-Aged Children from the PediaTrac™ Study."

title: Finals Lounge
description: Finals Lounge is Campus Life's one and only escape from finals week, with games, massages, crafts, and more!

title: Stress Relief: Play-doh Making and Zentangle
description: Need a reset from classes, deadlines, and finals? Join us for a hands-on relaxation event to unwind, get creative, and leave feeling lighter.

title: Esports Documentary Premiere
description: Join us for this year's EMU Esports documentary premiere titled "Collegiate Valorant". The film has a run time of an hour and covers the journey of EMU's most successful esports team ever.

title: Stress Relief: Yoga
description: Join us as we partner with the REC/IM for some Yoga to take a break from finals and deadlines for some stress relieving activity! Drop-in anytime between 12:30pm and 1:30pm.

title: Honors College Winter 2026 Graduation
description: The Honors College will hold an in-person graduate recognition ceremony at 10:30am on Friday, May 1, 2026 in Pease Auditorium. Graduates will begin checking in at 9:00am. No tickets required! This will be followed by a reception in the Honors College.

title: Multicultural Graduation Celebration
description: Multicultural Graduation Celebration honors the achievements of graduating students, both domestic and international and celebrates our diverse student body! Individuals Graduating in Winter, Spring/Summer and Fall 2026 are welcome to participate!

title: Colin Bieszard Masters Percussion Recital
description: Come enjoy Colin Bieszard's Masters Percussion recital!

title: Spring Commencement
description: We are pleased to announce that Eastern Michigan University will hold Commencement Ceremonies on Saturday, May 2, 20246, at 9:30 a.m. and 1:30 p.m. These ceremonies will be for students who have an active application to graduate in May 2026.

title: Emma Brooks Senior Bass Trombone Recital
description: Emma Brooks will perform a Senior Bass Trombone Recital.

title: Dissertation Defense - Sarah Freeman
description:
Title: Perinatal Mental Health and Relationships Matter: 
A Preliminary Evaluation of a Relational Perinatal Dialectical Behavior Therapy Group

title: AY2026-2027 Calendaring Summit
description: You're invited to join Campus Life on Thursday May 14 from 10:00am-2:00pm in the Honors College to collaborate in calendaring our AY26-27 student programming and events. We will dialogue, lunch, and plot out our anticipated initiatives. Please RSVP.

title: CMTA Coming Home Celebration: The Story Continues...
venue: Judy Sturgis Hill Building - Legacy Theatre
description: CMTA has always been more than a School. It's where storytellers, communicators, and creators first learned to find their voice and make meaning. We hope you'll come home to CMTA on May 16, share your story, and celebrate with your extended family!

title: Evening Light: Mozart's Vespers and Choral Twilight Reflections
description: Evening Light features Mozart’s Vespers and reflective choral works, performed by Beyond Choir in collaboration with EMU Choir and PCEP Choir—uniting voices across generations in a powerful shared performance.

title: Beyond Choir Concert- Mozart Vespers
description: Join Beyond for an extraordinary evening immersing yourself in Mozart's magnificent Vespers. Experience the profound beauty of this sacred choral masterpiece, brought to life by our professional ensemble's unparalleled performance. Free with EMU ID.

title: Occupational Therapy Zoom Group Advising Session
description: Come join our Zoom session to learn more about the occupational therapy program and how to apply. Email ot_intent_advising@emich.edu to RSVP. To join via Zoom, please use the link below and Meeting ID: 859 513
